item.title: Your Clicks Already Know You — The Problem Is You Don't Know That Yet
item.description: We built the internet around profiles and sign-up forms, but the systems serving us content stopped caring about those a long time ago. Your declared identity — the checkbox you ticked, the bio you wrote, the email address you handed over — is increasingly decorative. What actually determines what you see, what you’re sold, and what you’re nudged to believe is something you never explicitly provided: the rhythm of your clicks.
